name: Rust Onslaught
detailed_description:
Rust Onslaught is an original top-down shooter all about robot domination! Take control of R-75 as he cuts a swath through every machine he sees!

After a robot uprising in the distant past, only intelligent machines remain. Created as a warehouse guard, just another specialized cog in the system, you've been freed through a robot virus causing you and others to lash out in extreme violence!

Be Swift!

Stay on your toes as you parry, dash, and shoot your way through the rooms of the facility, fighting a variety of armed machines along the way. To heal, you must fight, taking energy from others by deflecting attacks or barreling right through them. No standing around and hiding for you!

Be Armed!

Throughout your conquest, gear up with the variety of firearms and equipment you'll encounter. Despite starting with a lowly pistol, prepare to mow down enemies with the Machine Gun, eliminate hordes with the Energy Gun, or perhaps switch up your strategy with the Sniper and many more weapons!

Be Vigilant!

Along your spree, you might encounter a variety of secrets. Hidden among the levels, new areas to explore and oddities to ogle may pop up if you search hard enough...

With various mechanical environments delivered alongside clean pixel-art graphics and an inspired score, Rust Onslaught is set to be both an engaging and interesting challenge to players of all varieties. Only one question remains now...Are you prepared?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Something That Can Run Basic Pixel Art.
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Resolution settings are not included, so the game scales from 1920x1080. This is not very noticable though, as it is pixel art.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Something That Can Run Basic Pixel Art Well.
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Contains Violent Deaths and Gore Of The Robots, But they are robots so there is not actual blood.
